sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: The SHACL graph is semantically faithful, but the COMPLETE dependency contract remains stale. Replace operandTerms continuousUseSuitabilityStatus with searchlightContinuousUseSuitabilityStatus so the declared operand matches the required searchlight-owned property actually checked. Preserve the current conditional ship applicability, universal validation of existing lifeboats without adding hasLifeboat minCount, and qualified requirement for at least one assigned suitable searchlight; do not reintroduce the generic ship-level property.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Remove the ship-level nltl:continuousUseSuitabilityStatus=true constraint: it invents a ship-wide obligation and duplicates the searchlight suitability fact on the wrong entity. Suitability must be checked only on each assigned nltl:searchlight via nltl:searchlightContinuousUseSuitabilityStatus=true, as the candidate otherwise does. Because the COMPLETE dependency contract incorrectly declares the generic ship-owned continuousUseSuitabilityStatus as the operand while the verified requirement and supplied specific property place suitability on the searchlight, correct the contract to name searchlightContinuousUseSuitabilityStatus before regenerating; the needed canonical term is already supplied, so no variable matcher is required.

Preserve the searchlight-owned suitability check and do not reintroduce the generic ship-level property. Correct the still-stale COMPLETE dependency contract by replacing operandTerms continuousUseSuitabilityStatus with searchlightContinuousUseSuitabilityStatus. Also encode the required existential alternative correctly: for each existing lifeboat, use a qualified value shape on hasAssignedSearchlight with sh:qualifiedMinCount 1, requiring an nltl:searchlight whose searchlightContinuousUseSuitabilityStatus is exactly true; the current sh:node constraint unnecessarily requires every assigned searchlight to be suitable. Do not add sh:minCount to hasLifeboat, because this universal rule does not independently require lifeboat existence.
